- pnpm lint - 0 errors / 11 unchanged warnings
- pnpm typecheck
- pnpm build - seven routes generated
- git diff --check and exact-main merge-tree passed
- accepted task browser and mounted-owner evidence reused; relevant product inputs remained unchanged
